description: This file defines two asynchronous functions, getUserCosts and getUserProjectsCosts, which perform complex MongoDB aggregations on the llmCosts model to compute user-specific cost summaries, including breakdowns by agent and type, as well as project-level costs with agent subtotals.

methods.name: getUserCosts
methods.description: Aggregates total cost for a user with breakdowns by agent and type, normalizing fields and handling nulls.

methods.name: getUserProjectsCosts
methods.description: Aggregates costs for a user grouped by project, with agent subtotals.
